scope: Only ordinary-return nonvolatile facts needed by register_type_server cached named-import calls. No dependency-body reconstruction or application credit.

qualification: Successful actually reached export calls were observed at their real App CALL/next-instruction sites with cdecl ESP and EBX/ESI/EDI/EBP preservation.
